# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** head and front of the enterprise  <sub>[v2 c14 P5](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is described as sonsy, kindly, and matronly. She sits frequently at her kitchen window keeping a sharp eye on everything that passes by on the main road.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel is a highly capable, practical, and energetic woman who manages her own affairs and freely manages those of her neighbors. Extremely outspoken, blunt, and opinionated, she prides herself on always speaking her mind without fear or favor. Though often regarded as a gossipy, severe, and bossy busybody, she possesses a good, kind heart and acts as a devoted, uncomplaining nurse when needed. She is a dedicated church member and a passionate politician who holds strong prejudices and believes in foreordination.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c20 P38](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0038), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived for forty-five years in Lynde's Hollow near Green Gables, managing her home, raising her family, and taking an active role in church societies and local politics. When Marilla Cuthbert adopted Anne Shirley, Rachel initially criticized Anne's looks and temper, leading to a clash before the two reconciled. Over the years, she offered advice to Matthew and Marilla, helped sew dresses for Anne, and took home first prize for butter and cheese at the Exhibition. After her husband Thomas grew ill and died, Rachel learned that their farm was heavily mortgaged to help their youngest son and would have to be sold. To keep her from having to leave Avonlea, Marilla invited her to move into Green Gables. Rachel accepted and moved into the spare room, where she took over household duties and assisted Marilla with raising the twins, Davy and Dora. She later traveled to Four Winds to visit Anne and Gilbert and share holiday dinners with them.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v2 c22 P11](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0011), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 c15 P2](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0002), [v4 c28 P30](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0030)_
